// REPLACE YOUR ENTIRE <script> SECTION WITH THIS

// Get DOM elements
const hubHeader = document.getElementById('hubHeader');
const backdropBlur = document.getElementById('backdropBlur');
const hubLogoMain = document.querySelector('.hub-logo-main');
const navTriggerLine = document.querySelector('.nav-trigger-line');
const navMenu = document.querySelector('.hub-nav-menu');

let isNavActive = false;
let openTimer = null;
let closeTimer = null;
let blurTimer = null;

// Check if mobile
function isMobile() {
    return window.innerWidth <= 768;
}

// Show navigation - menu first, then blur
function showNavigation() {
    if (isNavActive) return; // Already open, don't re-trigger
    
    isNavActive = true;
    
    // Clear all timers
    clearTimeout(closeTimer);
    clearTimeout(blurTimer);
    
    // Show menu immediately
    hubHeader.classList.add('nav-active');
    
    // Add blur after menu is visible (prevents blocking)
    blurTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (isNavActive) {
            backdropBlur.classList.add('active');
        }
    }, 300); // Delay blur until menu is mostly visible
}

// Hide navigation - blur first, then menu
function hideNavigation() {
    if (!isNavActive) return; // Already closed, don't re-trigger
    
    isNavActive = false;
    
    // Clear all timers
    clearTimeout(openTimer);
    clearTimeout(blurTimer);
    
    // Remove blur immediately
    backdropBlur.classList.remove('active');
    
    // Hide menu after a short delay
    setTimeout(() => {
        hubHeader.classList.remove('nav-active');
    }, 150);
}

// Setup hover behavior for desktop
function setupDesktopInteractions() {
    // Hover to open
    hubHeader.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        if (isMobile()) return;
        
        clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        clearTimeout(openTimer);
        
        // Small delay to prevent accidental triggers
        openTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            showNavigation();
        }, 200);
    });
    
    // Leave to close
    hubHeader.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
        if (isMobile()) return;
        
        clearTimeout(openTimer);
        clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        
        // Get the element the mouse is moving to
        const toElement = e.relatedTarget;
        
        // Don't close if moving to the navigation menu
        if (toElement && navMenu && navMenu.contains(toElement)) {
            return;
        }
        
        // Generous delay for user to move back
        closeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            hideNavigation();
        }, 600);
    });
    
    // Keep menu open when hovering over it
    if (navMenu) {
        navMenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            if (isMobile()) return;
            clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        });
        
        navMenu.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            if (isMobile()) return;
            
            closeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                hideNavigation();
            }, 400);
        });
    }
}

// Setup mobile click interactions
function setupMobileInteractions() {
    const toggleElements = [hubLogoMain, navTriggerLine];
    
    toggleElements.forEach(element => {
        if (element) {
            element.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (!isMobile()) return;
                
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                if (isNavActive) {
                    hideNavigation();
                } else {
                    showNavigation();
                }
            });
        }
    });
}

// Setup closing interactions
function setupClosingInteractions() {
    // Click backdrop to close
    backdropBlur.addEventListener('click', () => {
        hideNavigation();
    });
    
    // Click outside to close
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (isNavActive && !hubHeader.contains(e.target)) {
            hideNavigation();
        }
    });
    
    // Escape key to close
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && isNavActive) {
            hideNavigation();
        }
    });
    
    // Close when clicking navigation links
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Instant close for navigation
            isNavActive = false;
            backdropBlur.classList.remove('active');
            hubHeader.classList.remove('nav-active');
            clearTimeout(blurTimer);
            clearTimeout(closeTimer);
            clearTimeout(openTimer);
        });
    });
}

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (isMobile() && isNavActive) {
        hideNavigation();
    }
});

// Initialize everything
setupDesktopInteractions();
setupMobileInteractions();
setupClosingInteractions();

// Loading screen
window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    const loadingContainer = document.getElementById('loadingContainer');
    if (loadingContainer) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            loadingContainer.classList.add('hidden');
        }, 500);
    }
});

// Card animations
const observerOptions = {
    threshold: 0.1,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
};

const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
            entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }
    });
}, observerOptions);

document.querySelectorAll('.nav-card').forEach(card => {
    card.style.opacity = '0';
    card.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
    card.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease';
    observer.observe(card);
});
